title: Engagement Plan
subtitle: How we scope, propose, refine, award, and prepare an engagement.

steps.title: Client Request
steps.body: Receive the inquiry, objective, target environment, timing, and constraints.

steps.title: Qualification & Scoping
steps.body: Clarify scope, assumptions, rules of engagement, dependencies, and required access.

steps.title: Proposal Drafting
steps.body: Draft the approach, estimate effort, identify deliverables, and define communication cadence.

steps.title: Proposal Delivery
steps.body: Present the statement of work, pricing model, schedule, and expected client responsibilities.

steps.title: Refinement
steps.body: Resolve questions, adjust scope, confirm testing model, and capture agreed revisions.

steps.title: Award & Contracting
steps.body: Record approval, finalize terms, align start date, and confirm billing / legal path.

steps.title: SEP Preparation
steps.body: Create the secure workspace, prepare tooling, define evidence handling, and stage the test plan.

steps.title: Kickoff & Access Readiness
steps.body: Confirm contacts, credentials, communication channels, and pre-flight prerequisites.

steps.title: Engagement Plan Issued
steps.body: Deliver the structured plan covering scope, methodology, schedule, reporting, and retest path.

title: Executive Brief
subtitle: How we distill results into clear decisions for technical and business stakeholders.

steps.title: Scope & Context
steps.body: Reconfirm the engagement objective, tested surface, constraints, and operating assumptions.

steps.title: Evidence Review
steps.body: Consolidate validated evidence, affected assets, and proof supporting each finding.

steps.title: Findings Summary
steps.body: Present the most important findings, severity distribution, and the story of what matters.

steps.title: Risk Themes
steps.body: Group issues into patterns such as access control, exposure, configuration, or process weakness.

steps.title: Business Impact
steps.body: Translate technical issues into operational, financial, and decision-making consequences.

steps.title: Technical Impact
steps.body: Explain exploitability, attack paths, dependencies, and likely remediation effort.

steps.title: Priority Actions
steps.body: Identify immediate actions, near-term remediation, and longer-term program improvements.

steps.title: Stakeholder Alignment
steps.body: Shape the message for executives, delivery leaders, technical owners, and procurement stakeholders.

steps.title: Executive Brief Issued
steps.body: Deliver the structured brief covering outcomes, risk, priorities, and recommended next steps.

title: Remediation Guidance
subtitle: How we convert findings into practical, prioritized remediation guidance.

steps.title: Finding Validation
steps.body: Confirm the issue, affected assets, evidence quality, and remediation trigger.

steps.title: Root Cause Review
steps.body: Identify whether the problem stems from design, configuration, implementation, process, or dependency.

steps.title: Risk & Priority
steps.body: Align severity, exploitability, exposure, and business context into remediation priority.

steps.title: Fix Strategy
steps.body: Define the preferred corrective action, secure design approach, and expected target state.

steps.title: Compensating Controls
steps.body: Identify temporary safeguards or containment actions when immediate fix is not possible.

steps.title: Engineering Guidance
steps.body: Provide implementation notes, secure coding or configuration direction, and ownership expectations.

steps.title: Validation Criteria
steps.body: Define what must be true for the issue to be considered remediated.

steps.title: Coordination & Scheduling
steps.body: Align remediation owners, decision makers, testing windows, and communication cadence.

steps.title: Guidance Issued
steps.body: Deliver the remediation package with priorities, rationale, and closure path.

title: Retest Support
subtitle: How we verify remediation, assess residual risk, and close the loop.

steps.title: Remediation Notice
steps.body: Receive the client update describing fixes, environment changes, and retest scope.

steps.title: Scope Review
steps.body: Confirm what findings, assets, versions, or controls are in scope for retesting.

steps.title: Readiness Check
steps.body: Verify access, credentials, timing, communications, and prerequisites before testing resumes.

steps.title: Evidence Review
steps.body: Review remediation notes, change records, and supporting implementation evidence.

steps.title: Focused Retesting
steps.body: Execute targeted validation against the original finding and affected pathways.

steps.title: Residual Risk Review
steps.body: Determine whether risk remains, has shifted, or is fully addressed.

steps.title: Follow-on Findings
steps.body: Record any new observations, regressions, or related weaknesses exposed by remediation.

steps.title: Closure Decision
steps.body: Confirm fixed, partially fixed, or not fixed status and align closure language.

steps.title: Retest Report Issued
steps.body: Deliver the retest outcome, verified status, residual risk view, and next steps.
